_note: Knobs for zone.py (ZoneParams) and drops.py (DropParams); partial overrides allowed, a bad file = defaults.

finisher._note: focus soonest kill, lock targets < lock_frac HP, stay in fight if target dies within finish_s; chase_s 0 = no chasing (leaving cover lost in real practice)

roof._note: roof.py: from start_s, climb a roof inside the next circle and hold it (stand back from the edges)

aggro._note: all-out aggression: fight anything within 230 m, flee only < 25% HP vs 2+, hunt the last known enemy instead of hiding

roam_fix._note: roam to points with free ground nearby; after a failed A* for a goal, walk straight for 3 s before retrying it

unstick._note: docs/stuck_pocket.md: escalating unstick (repeat stuck at one spot = climb toward the goal / slide one side), off = old _unstick

late._note: late.py: from next circle <= start_next_r, hold a concealed spot inside it instead of roam/hold/hunt; skip cubes past cube_cap

upgrade_ctx._note: pick upgrades by the weapon we hold and the weapons seen on enemies (Bot._upgrade_scores); off = fixed UPGRADE_PREF

weapon_ctx._note: weapon rank shifted by the weapon triangle vs weapons seen on enemies (Bot._ranks); off = fixed WEAPON_RANK

special_guard._note: no weapon swap that drops a held weapon while an enemy mech is within enemy_r or we were hit within quiet_s (Bot._take, Bot._in_fight)

mortar_lead._note: lead mortar shells by the target's velocity times the shell flight time (Bot._mortar_lead); off = aim at the target

early_evade._note: Step 2: (any aggro setting) break off to cover when >= `attackers` different mechs hit us within `window_s` and HP < `hp_frac`. enabled=false restores main.

dodge._note: Step 1: sidestep incoming gun bullets and mortar shells; add beam shooters to known enemy positions. enabled=false restores main.

unseen_hit._note: a mech we can't see hit us within window_s: `cover` = evade to cover that blocks its bearing (unless the target dies within finish_s), `face` = turn the torso to it. enabled=false restores the branch base.

evade_fix._note: once evade starts, stay in it commit_s (unless the target dies within unseen_hit.finish_s); cover search out to the last of radii. enabled=false restores the branch base.
